statement.excerpt: There is simply no space in these projections to absorb that $300 billion, and from what I can tell, by 2029, OpenAI will have actually burned more than $290 billion, assuming that it survives that long, which I do not believe it will.

from_speaker: assuming that it survives that long, which I do not believe it will
our_interpretation: This assessment covers the survival prediction, not the adjacent cash-burn estimate.
Survival means continuing to operate as a business. A financing round, change of ownership, or corporate restructuring alone does not constitute failure.
The latest possible deadline is December 31, 2029. 'Survives that long' could instead mean reaching the beginning of 2029; that distinction does not affect the present assessment.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI permanently ceases business operations by the deadline, with no continuing business successor.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI continues operating through the deadline.
